// Generated by the RipulAgent package's RipulThemeRedirect build-tool plug-in.
// It is written into the build folder on every build and is not part of your sources.
//
// Inside this module the declarations below are chosen over SwiftUI's of the same name,
// so `.font(.body)`, `.foregroundStyle(.secondary)` and `Color(.systemBackground)` in
// your own files follow the theme with no line of them changed. With no theme each one
// returns exactly what SwiftUI's would have (docs/theming-for-hosts.md).
//
// To leave a part out, add its flag to the target's Swift compilation conditions:
//   RIPUL_THEME_NO_ROOT     keep SwiftUI's WindowGroup; put `.ripulThemeRoot()` on your root yourself
//   RIPUL_THEME_NO_STYLES   keep SwiftUI's foregroundStyle; the hierarchy styles stay the system's

import SwiftUI
import RipulAgent
#if canImport(UIKit)
import UIKit
#endif

// MARK: Text styles and system fonts

extension Font {
    static var largeTitle: Font { RipulThemeRedirect.font(.largeTitle) }
    static var title: Font { RipulThemeRedirect.font(.title) }
    static var title2: Font { RipulThemeRedirect.font(.title2) }
    static var title3: Font { RipulThemeRedirect.font(.title3) }
    static var headline: Font { RipulThemeRedirect.font(.headline) }
    static var subheadline: Font { RipulThemeRedirect.font(.subheadline) }
    static var body: Font { RipulThemeRedirect.font(.body) }
    static var callout: Font { RipulThemeRedirect.font(.callout) }
    static var footnote: Font { RipulThemeRedirect.font(.footnote) }
    static var caption: Font { RipulThemeRedirect.font(.caption) }
    static var caption2: Font { RipulThemeRedirect.font(.caption2) }

    static func system(size: CGFloat, weight: Font.Weight? = nil, design: Font.Design? = nil) -> Font {
        RipulThemeRedirect.systemFont(size: size, weight: weight, design: design)
    }

    static func system(_ style: Font.TextStyle, design: Font.Design? = nil, weight: Font.Weight? = nil) -> Font {
        RipulThemeRedirect.systemFont(style, design: design, weight: weight)
    }

    // The font itself. These only let a symbol keep its system size (see `Image.font`).
    func weight(_ weight: Font.Weight) -> Font { RipulThemeRedirect.weight(self, weight) }
    func bold() -> Font { RipulThemeRedirect.bold(self) }
    func italic() -> Font { RipulThemeRedirect.italic(self) }
}

extension Image {
    /// A font on a symbol is its size, not type: it keeps the system's.
    /// (`Font`, where SwiftUI's takes `Font?`: the closer match is the one chosen.)
    func font(_ font: Font) -> some View {
        RipulThemeRedirect.iconFont(self, font)
    }
}

// MARK: Colours

extension Color {
    static var red: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.danger) }
    static var orange: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.warning) }
    static var green: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.success) }
    static var blue: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.info) }
    static var gray: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.neutral) }
    static var primary: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.text) }
    static var secondary: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.textSecondary) }

    #if canImport(UIKit)
    init(_ color: UIColor) { self = RipulThemeRedirect.color(color) }
    init(uiColor: UIColor) { self = RipulThemeRedirect.color(uiColor) }
    #endif
}

extension ShapeStyle where Self == Color {
    static var red: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.danger) }
    static var orange: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.warning) }
    static var green: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.success) }
    static var blue: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.info) }
    static var gray: Color { RipulThemeRedirect.color(.neutral) }
}

#if !RIPUL_THEME_NO_STYLES
// `.primary`, `.secondary`, `.tertiary` and `.quaternary`. Not generic, where SwiftUI's
// is: for a hierarchy style this is the closer match, and every other style is SwiftUI's.
extension View {
    func foregroundStyle(_ style: HierarchicalShapeStyle) -> some View {
        RipulThemeRedirect.foregroundStyle(self, style)
    }
}

extension Text {
    func foregroundStyle(_ style: HierarchicalShapeStyle) -> Text {
        RipulThemeRedirect.foregroundStyle(self, style)
    }
}
#endif

// MARK: The root

#if !RIPUL_THEME_NO_ROOT
/// SwiftUI's `WindowGroup`, with the theme root round its content. The theme is the one
/// Info.plist names under `RipulTheme`.
private func ripulThemeRedirectRoot<Content: View>(_ content: @escaping () -> Content) -> RipulThemeRedirect.Root<Content> {
    #if DEBUG
    RipulThemeRedirect.useUsageMap(ripulThemeRedirectUsageMap)
    #endif
    return RipulThemeRedirect.Root(content)
}

struct WindowGroup<Content: View>: Scene {
    private let scene: SwiftUI.WindowGroup<RipulThemeRedirect.Root<Content>>

    init(@ViewBuilder content: @escaping () -> Content) {
        scene = SwiftUI.WindowGroup { ripulThemeRedirectRoot(content) }
    }

    init(id: String, @ViewBuilder content: @escaping () -> Content) {
        scene = SwiftUI.WindowGroup(id: id) { ripulThemeRedirectRoot(content) }
    }

    init(_ title: LocalizedStringKey, @ViewBuilder content: @escaping () -> Content) {
        scene = SwiftUI.WindowGroup(title) { ripulThemeRedirectRoot(content) }
    }

    init(_ title: LocalizedStringKey, id: String, @ViewBuilder content: @escaping () -> Content) {
        scene = SwiftUI.WindowGroup(title, id: id) { ripulThemeRedirectRoot(content) }
    }

    var body: some Scene { scene }
}
#endif

// MARK: The View Explorer's map

/*USAGE-MAP*/
"""#
#endif
